_how: Every word tviz shows (WIP202610052). {name} placeholders are filled by core/format.js fill().
Same keys as th.json (lib/tviz/atdd/format.test.js fails if they drift). A host overrides any key with options.text.

captions.x: Each token is a row of numbers (its vector). With position on, X0 = X + P.
captions.qkv: X0 (n × d) · W_Q (d × d_k) = Q (n × d_k); the same for K and V.
captions.raw: Score of query i and key j = q_i · k_j. One row per query token.
captions.scaled: Divide every score by √d_k so the softmax does not get too sharp.
captions.mask: Causal mask: a token may not look at later tokens; their scores become −∞.
captions.maskOff: Causal mask is off: every token may look at every token.
captions.softmax: Softmax per row: weights above 0 that add up to 1.
captions.out: out = A · V: each token's new vector is a weighted mix of the value rows.

sampling.ruleTopK: top-k keeps the k most likely tokens; on a tie the earlier token wins.
sampling.ruleTopP: top-p keeps the smallest set of most likely tokens whose probabilities add up to at least p.

errors.sourceNone: Give one of trace, weights or seed.
errors.sourceMany: Give only one of trace, weights or seed.
errors.notMatrix: {path}: expected a matrix (a list of rows).
errors.ragged: {path}: every row must have the same length.
errors.notFinite: {path}: every value must be a finite number.
errors.blockPartial: {path}: give all of Wo, W1 and W2, or none of them.
errors.missingA: {path}: every head needs its attention weights A.
errors.rowSum: {path}: each row of A must add up to 1.
errors.badInt: {path}: expected a whole number of at least {min}.
